subtitle: UPDATE Aug 18, 47 days from the first round and on the THIRD DAY OF THE OFFICIAL CAMPAIGN. THE DISTANCE BETWEEN LULA AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO NARROWED FOR THE SECOND DAY RUNNING and closed at 31.45pp, against 37.05pp on Aug 16, in a presidential book that has accumulated USD 128.96M. The only national poll of the week, BTG/Nexus of Aug 17 (n=2,003, field Aug 14 to 16, BR-03317/2026), said the opposite: the distance between the two did NOT change, it stayed at the same 5 points. RONALDO CAIADO rose in the contract on winning and fell in the third place one on the same day. Datafolha and Veritá publish on Aug 21, both already in the field, and Datafolha is the first to measure Pablo Marçal.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 63.50% (vol USD 8.67M accumulated), confirmed reading of Aug 18, 10:32 PM BRT (01:32 UTC)
fortes: Today's BTG/Nexus puts him at 41% in the first round, up 1 point against the same house's previous round, which had him at 40%.
In the stimulated runoff he appears with 47% against 44%, a result IDENTICAL to the house's previous round, keeping the 3-point advantage.
The distance to the runner-up in the poll stays at 5 points, the same as the previous round, meaning the challenger's gain did not shorten the measured interval.
In the price he remains far ahead, at 64.50% against 31.45%, and his contract holds USD 8.52M inside a presidential book of USD 126.85M.
Of the 90 days in the series recorded since May 19, only 5 are above today's close.
fracos: 🔴 A 2.00pp DROP in the price in one day, from 66.50% to 64.50%, giving back exactly what he had gained the day before.
The distance to the runner-up in the price CLOSED from 37.05pp to 33.05pp, that is 4.00pp in about 26 hours.
The government assessment in today's BTG/Nexus has 42% rating it bad or terrible against 34% excellent or good, with 23% average.
⛔ No upside superlative applies: the series high remains 66.50%, from Aug 1, and today's value sits below it.

The Federal Police found a message in which his son and a lobbyist under investigation for INSS fraud discuss business, and the runner-up and his brother used the case the same day, according to Poder360.
candidates.analise: PRICE at 63.50% (vol USD 8.67M accumulated), confirmed reading of Aug 18, 10:32 PM BRT (01:32 UTC), down 1.00pp. THE DISTANCE to the runner-up NARROWED 1.60pp to 31.45pp, the second day running of convergence: it was 37.05pp on Aug 16 and 33.05pp on Aug 17. 🔑 THE BALLOT BOX SAYS THE OPPOSITE: BTG/Nexus of Aug 17 took him from 40% to 41% and his opponent from 35% to 36%, so the distance between the two did NOT change, it stayed at 5 points, and each move fits inside the 2pp margin. A measurement that does not narrow cannot explain a narrowing. 📌 In STATE polls today he trails in Paraná, 35% against 52% in the runoff, and leads in Pernambuco, 58% against 24%; state polls do not enter the national panel. ⛔ No superlative: the high of the 88-day series is still 66.50%, from Aug 1. 📅 Datafolha and Veritá publish on Aug 21, both already in the field.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 32.05% (vol USD 8.62M accumulated), confirmed reading of Aug 18, 10:32 PM BRT (01:32 UTC)
fortes: 🔴 A 2.00pp RISE in the price in one day, from 29.45% to 31.45%, and it is the fourth straight day of gains.
The distance to the leader in the price CLOSED 4.00pp in about 26 hours, from 37.05pp to 33.05pp.
Today's BTG/Nexus takes him from 35% to 36% in the first round, and in the runoff he repeats the 44% of the previous round.
He dominates the first-round second place contract with 85.50%, far ahead of the next name in that book.
The negative assessment of the incumbent administration stands at 42% bad or terrible in the same BTG/Nexus.
fracos: ⛔ Not a record: of the 90 days in the series since May 19, 2 are above today's close, and the high remains 33.20%, from Jun 2.
In the poll the distance to the leader did NOT change: it was 5 points and it is still 5 points, because both rose 1 point.
The 1-point gain sits inside the house's own 2pp margin, so it is not distinguishable from stability.
In the runoff he remains 3 points behind, 44% against 47%, exactly as in the previous round.

His campaign spent the day in a dispute with a rival from his own side: he accused Caiado of helping the leader, after Kassab said Caiado has zero chance, and Kassab replied that his campaign is worried about Caiado, according to Estadão.
candidates.analise: PRICE at 32.05% (vol USD 8.62M accumulated), confirmed reading of Aug 18, 10:32 PM BRT (01:32 UTC), up 0.60pp and a fifth day running of gains. In the SECOND PLACE contract he marks 88.50%. ⛔ NOT a record: the high of the 88-day series is 33.20%, from Jun 2. 📌 IN THE BALLOT BOX, BTG/Nexus of Aug 17 has him at 36% in the first round and 44% in the runoff, with the distance to the leader at the same 5 points. In a STATE poll in Paraná he stands at 52% against 35% in the runoff, according to Poder360 and CartaCapital, and state polls do not enter the national panel.

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: PRICE: 4.40% (vol USD 10.11M accumulated), confirmed reading of Aug 18, 10:32 PM BRT (01:32 UTC)
fortes: He still leads the first-round third place contract, at 52.50%, the highest probability in that book.
His contract has the LARGEST accumulated volume in the presidential book, at USD 9.95M, above the leader's own.
Today's BTG/Nexus keeps him at 4% in the first round, the same level as recent national polls.
He opened his campaign in São Paulo on Aug 16 with a security-focused speech, according to O Globo and G1.
He publicly assessed that Pablo Marçal's possible entry into the race would benefit his rival on the right, and not him.
fracos: 🔴 A CONTINUED DROP in the price, from 4.70% to 4.05%, and the value sits BELOW any close recorded in the 90-day series, whose floor was 4.80%.

⚠️ His book is THIN, and that matters for reading the move: in the presidential contract he is worth a little over 4%, and in that range little money moves the price. The placement reading, in the third place contract, is where he carries real weight.
In the third place contract he also gave ground, from 53.00% to 52.50%, and the distance to the second name in that book narrowed from 15.50pp to 14.00pp.
🔴 IN THE POLL HE IS BEHIND CAIADO: today's BTG/Nexus gives Caiado 5% and him 4%.
His series high is 17.90%, from Jun 9, meaning today's price is less than a quarter of that value.
candidates.analise: PRICE at 4.40% (vol USD 10.11M accumulated), confirmed reading of Aug 18, 10:32 PM BRT (01:32 UTC), up 0.35pp. ⭐ THE STRONG MOVE WAS IN PLACEMENT: in the THIRD PLACE contract he jumped from 52.50% to 57.00%, and his distance to Caiado in that book REOPENED from 14.00pp to 20.00pp, undoing two days of convergence. 📌 THE DISAGREEMENT WITH THE BALLOT BOX CONTINUES AND IS INVERTED: BTG/Nexus of Aug 17 gives Caiado 5% and him 4%, while the market keeps him 20 points ahead in the placement contract. These are different questions: the poll measures declared intention, the contract measures probability of placement.

candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema
candidates.header: PRICE for the whole pack, confirmed reading of Aug 18, 10:32 PM BRT (01:32 UTC): Ronaldo Caiado 0.80% (vol USD 6.34M), Pablo Marçal 0.90% (vol USD 1.66M), Romeu Zema 0.15% (vol USD 5.71M), Fernando Haddad 0.05% and Tarcísio de Freitas 0.05% (vol USD 13.93M, the largest in the book).
candidates.subtitle: Aug 16, first day of campaigning: all three opened their schedules, and in the price all three fell. The crossing that matters is about CONTRACTS, because Caiado goes down on victory and up on placing.

caiado.label: CAIADO (PSD), presidential Poly 0.60% (vol USD 5.92M cumulative, confirmed reading of Aug 16, 4:56 pm BRT (7:56 pm UTC)), down 0.45pp | first-round third place at 37.50% | polling in force: Quaest 4%, Gerp 4%, Meio/Ideia 5.7%, BTG/Nexus 5% | REJECTION of 35% in the Quaest of Aug 14
caiado.fortes: ⭐ His THIRD-PLACE contract stands at 37.50%, against 31.00% at the Aug 12 close, a 6.50pp rise with four straight higher closes. In other words, the market moved him closer on PLACING while moving him away from VICTORY. In the polling he still has 4% in the Quaest of Aug 14 and the lowest rejection in the field, 35%. He opened the campaign with a mass at the Goiânia cathedral and a motorcade through Goiás and the Federal District outskirts, according to Folha de S.Paulo and G1, and said the United States does not rule Brazil, according to Times Brasil.
caiado.fracos: In the victory price he fell 0.45pp and moved to 0.60%, brushing the 0.5% cutoff. ⚠️ The 35% rejection comes with high name-recognition gaps declared by the house itself, and low rejection with high unfamiliarity is not acceptance: it means most of the electorate has not yet formed an opinion, and an unformed opinion can go either way. His contrast remains the widest on the panel, with 4% to 5.7% of declared intention against less than 1% of victory price.

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), presidential Poly 0.05% (vol USD 7.09M cumulative, confirmed reading of Aug 16, 4:56 pm BRT (7:56 pm UTC)), down 0.10pp and below the 0.5% cutoff
haddad.fortes: His cumulative volume remains larger than that of several names priced above him, which keeps the contract with trading depth despite the floor-level price. He spoke at the president's campaign-opening rally in the ABC region, according to O Globo.
haddad.fracos: ⭐ The caveat the panel had been repeating as an inference became a DATED FACT on Aug 16: he formally opened a campaign for the GOVERNORSHIP OF SÃO PAULO, according to O Globo and Times Brasil. That is, he is not a presidential candidate, and any presidential scenario that includes him is a polling hypothesis, not a candidacy under way. No national poll in the window tests him. The price fell to 0.05%, and variation in that band carries no informational value.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), presidential Poly 0.15% (vol USD 5.49M cumulative, confirmed reading of Aug 16, 4:56 pm BRT (7:56 pm UTC)), down 0.20pp and below the 0.5% cutoff | first-round third place at 5.00%
zema.fortes: The Quaest of Aug 14 keeps him at 2% in the first round, the same value as Aug 5, and BTG/Nexus's 3% and Meio/Ideia's 2.6% still stand. He was the first of the chasing pack to file with the electoral court, on Aug 6. He opened the campaign with a mass in Montes Claros, in northern Minas Gerais, promising a maximum-security prison and criticising Supreme Court justices, according to Folha de S.Paulo and Valor Econômico.
zema.fracos: 🔴 The Quaest firmness crosstab released on Aug 15 shows he has the LEAST CONVINCED electorate in the field, according to G1, which speaks to how solid his support is rather than how large. In the price he fell 0.20pp and moved to 0.15%, below the 0.5% cutoff. In the third-place contract he has 5.00%, far behind the 53.00% of the chasing pack's leader.

candidates.analise: ⭐ RONALDO CAIADO IS THE CROSSING OF THE DAY, AND IT IS AGAINST HIMSELF. In the contract on WINNING he more than tripled, from 0.25% to 0.80% (vol USD 6.34M), confirmed reading of Aug 18, 10:32 PM BRT (01:32 UTC), and returned above the 0.5% cut the panel uses to separate price from noise. In the THIRD PLACE contract he GAVE GROUND, from 38.50% to 37.00%. Both moves are from the same day and point opposite ways. ⛔ NO SUPERLATIVE: 0.80% is a recovery from the series low, 0.50% on Aug 15, and not proximity to the high, which is 2.40%, from Jun 19; of the 86 days recorded since May 21, 84 had a value equal to or above today's. 📌 The PSD confirmed his presidential candidacy, according to Acessa.com. PABLO MARÇAL repeated 0.90%, with volume going from USD 1.21M to USD 1.66M in one day, and 🏷️ his electoral status changed today: he asked the electoral court to correct his asset declaration and declared wealth fell from R$ 7.4 billion to R$ 149.9 million, according to G1 and Valor Econômico, which belong to the same group. He remains INELIGIBLE until 2032, with campaigning allowed by injunction and registration pending. ROMEU ZEMA fell to 0.15%. TARCÍSIO remains a candidate for re-election as governor of São Paulo and HADDAD for governor of São Paulo, with their contracts at the floor.
fortes: ⭐ CAIADO ROSE IN THE POSITION CONTRACT: first-round third place went from 37.50% to 38.50%, and his distance to the leader of that book closed from 15.50pp to 14.00pp.
In today's BTG/Nexus Caiado has 5% in the first round, ABOVE Renan Santos's 4%, inverting the ordering the market prices.
Zema has 4% in the same BTG/Nexus, tied with Renan Santos inside the 2pp margin.
The runner-up's campaign treated Caiado as a problem on the same day: Kassab said the campaign is worried about Caiado, according to Estadão.

Pablo Marçal is priced at 0.90%, with USD 1.21M accumulated, and will be included in the Datafolha survey scheduled for Aug 21, according to Valor Econômico. 🏷️ He filed for registration and is among the 13 who did so, and an injunction cleared him to campaign, but he is INELIGIBLE until 2032 and the registration remains pending a decision by the electoral court, according to BBC, G1 and Folha de S.Paulo.
fracos: 🔴 Caiado FELL in the win contract, from 0.60% to 0.25%, below the 0.50% floor recorded in the 90-day series.
Zema remains at 0.25%, below the 0.5% cut the panel uses to separate price from noise.
Both win contracts in the pack sit at a level where a one-hundredth change already shifts the relative percentage, and the panel treats that as shape, not signal.
Kassab, who is the running mate on Caiado's ticket, publicly said he has zero chance in the election, and then said he had been misinterpreted, according to Folha de S.Paulo and Estadão.
Zema opened the week promising a maximum-security prison and criticising Supreme Court justices, and that still has no translation into price, with 4.95% in the third place contract.

cruzamento: ⭐ THE FINDING OF THE DAY IS A DIVERGENCE OF DIRECTION BETWEEN THE TWO UNIVERSES THE PANEL MEASURES. In the confirmed reading of Aug 18, 10:32 PM BRT (01:32 UTC), LULA closed at 63.50% (vol USD 8.67M), down 1.00pp, and FLÁVIO BOLSONARO at 32.05% (vol USD 8.62M), up 0.60pp. The distance between them narrowed 1.60pp to 31.45pp, the SECOND day running of convergence: it was 37.05pp on Aug 16 and 33.05pp on Aug 17, that is 5.60pp in two days. 🔑 THE BALLOT BOX SAYS THE OPPOSITE: BTG/Nexus of Aug 17 measured Lula going from 40% to 41% and Flávio from 35% to 36%, which leaves the difference between them INTACT at 5 points, and each 1-point move fits inside the house's own 2pp margin. A measurement that does not narrow cannot explain a narrowing. ⛔ Same direction is not causation, and OPPOSITE direction is not either: the panel records both readings and does not arbitrate. ⭐⭐ THE SECOND CROSSING IS RONALDO CAIADO AGAINST HIMSELF. He more than tripled in the contract on WINNING, from 0.25% to 0.80% (vol USD 6.34M), returning above the 0.5% cut the panel uses to separate price from noise; and he GAVE GROUND in the THIRD PLACE contract, from 38.50% to 37.00%. Winning the election and finishing third are different questions, and in this round they pointed opposite ways. ⛔ NO SUPERLATIVE about him: 0.80% is a recovery from the series low, 0.50% on Aug 15, and not proximity to the high, which is 2.40%, from Jun 19. Of the 86 days recorded since May 21, 84 had a value equal to or above today's. 📌 AND RENAN SANTOS REOPENED THE LEAD HE HAD BEEN LOSING: in the third place contract he jumped from 52.50% to 57.00%, and his distance to Caiado went back from 14.00pp to 20.00pp, undoing two days of convergence. In declared intention the order is still reversed, with Caiado at 5% against Renan's 4%. 📅 No new national poll came in: the electoral court ingestion read 606 records and found none. Real Time Big Data publishes on Aug 19, and Datafolha and Veritá on Aug 21.
